comparison.objective: Run a press safely using both hand controls, then remove the finished part.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained simultaneous button holding and post-cycle retrieval, not precision tool striking.
comparison.success_condition: Both buttons held throughout die closure, hands remain outside the die, then part moves to the tray.
comparison.reason: This tests procedural interlocking and timing rather than contact-driven component finishing. No specs or exact concurrency/timing thresholds are supplied.
